meta.disclaimer: Only events with a dated source are shown as confirmed. Dates, venues and admission can still change: open the organiser or authority link before booking transport or accommodation.

events.name: Botswana Day public holidays
events.description: Two consecutive public-holiday dates can affect offices, border-related services and local business hours. Confirm any time-sensitive arrangements.
events.planningNote: Celebrate respectfully and check opening hours rather than assuming normal weekday service.

events.name: Hermanus Whale Festival
events.description: An eco-marine festival built around shore-based whale watching, conservation education, markets and family programming.
events.planningNote: Book the Overberg stay early and treat whale sightings as nature-dependent, not guaranteed.

events.name: Keetmanshoop Expo
events.description: A regional agricultural, industrial and tourism showcase in southern Namibia.
events.planningNote: Useful on a southern Namibia road trip; confirm the public programme and venue before changing your route.

events.name: Rundu Trade Fair
events.description: A regional fair bringing businesses, visitors and tourism promotion together in Namibia's northeast.
events.planningNote: Check the daily public programme; some sessions may be intended for business participants.

events.name: Victoria Falls Carnival
events.description: A New Year music and culture programme in Victoria Falls during one of the town's busiest travel periods.
events.planningNote: Confirm the organiser's final programme and book accommodation and transfers well ahead.

events.name: MTN Bushfire — 20th edition
events.description: The music and arts festival returns for its twentieth edition at House On Fire.
events.planningNote: Accommodation across Malkerns, Ezulwini and nearby towns becomes constrained; use the organiser's transport guidance.

watchlist.name: Lake of Stars 2027
watchlist.description: The planned 2–4 October 2026 festival was postponed. Do not book around the old dates; wait for the organiser's 2027 announcement.
watchlist.sourceLabel: Music In Africa — organiser postponement statement

watchlist.name: Kuomboka Ceremony 2027
watchlist.timing: Usually March–May; exact date is flood-dependent
watchlist.description: The Barotse Royal Establishment sets the ceremony date according to flood conditions. Treat any predicted day as unconfirmed.

watchlist.name: Lesotho festival dates
watchlist.description: Visit Lesotho lists recurring festivals, but exact 2027 dates are not yet published. Use the official calendar before planning around one.
